info.title: Sim API v2 — Files & Audit Logs
info.description:
Version 2 of the Sim REST API for the Files and Audit Logs surfaces.

## Conventions (v2)

Every v2 endpoint shares one response family:

- **Single resource:** `{ "data": T }`
- **List:** `{ "data": T[], "nextCursor": string | null }`
- **Error:** `{ "error": { "code": string, "message": string, "details"?: unknown } }`

### Cursor pagination

Lists use an opaque keyset cursor (Stripe/Slack-style): pass `limit` and `cursor` in, receive `data` and `nextCursor` out. Treat `cursor` as opaque — pass back the `nextCursor` from the previous page verbatim. When `nextCursor` is `null` there are no more results. Total counts are not returned on lists.

### Rate limiting

Rate-limit state is carried in response headers, not the body: `X-RateLimit-Limit`, `X-RateLimit-Remaining`, and `X-RateLimit-Reset` (an ISO 8601 timestamp). A throttled request returns `429` with a `Retry-After` header (seconds).

### Authentication

All endpoints authenticate with the `X-API-Key` header (a personal or workspace API key). Files endpoints are workspace-scoped via the required `workspaceId` query parameter. Audit Logs endpoints are organization-scoped enterprise endpoints and require an Enterprise subscription plus an organization admin or owner role.

tags.name: Files
tags.description: Upload, download, list, rename, delete, share, and replace the contents of workspace files (v2). Workspace-scoped via the required workspaceId query parameter or body field.

tags.name: Audit Logs
tags.description: Query the organization audit trail (v2). Organization-scoped enterprise endpoints requiring an Enterprise subscription and an organization admin or owner role.

get.description: List a workspace's files with opaque cursor pagination. Pass the `nextCursor` from a previous response to fetch the next page; a `null` `nextCursor` means there are no more results. Use `folderPath` to return only files directly inside one canonical folder path; omit it to list files from every folder.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of files to return per page. Clamped to the range 1–1000. Defaults to 100.

parameters.name: folderPath
parameters.description: Restrict the list to one folder. Omit to list every file in the workspace.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Case-insensitive substring match against the file `name`. Matches nothing else — not ids, descriptions, or content. `%` and `_` are matched literally. Must be non-empty; omit the parameter instead of sending a blank one.

parameters.name: sortBy
parameters.description: Field to sort by. The cursor is a keyset over the active sort, so it carries the sort it was minted under. Replaying a cursor after changing `sortBy` or `sortOrder` returns `400`; restart pagination without a cursor instead.

parameters.name: sortOrder
parameters.description: Sort direction. The cursor is a keyset over the active sort, so it carries the sort it was minted under. Replaying a cursor after changing `sortBy` or `sortOrder` returns `400`; restart pagination without a cursor instead.

post.description: Create an authored workspace file, either empty or with initial inline content. Use this endpoint for files whose bytes are already available as UTF-8 text or base64 and are at most 50 MiB after decoding. Use the upload-session endpoints for streamed or larger files. A live file with the same name in the same folder is rejected with `409`.

workspaceId.description: Workspace in which to create the file.

name.description: File name, including its extension. Path separators and dot segments are rejected.

contentType.description: MIME type. When omitted, it is inferred from the file extension.

folderPath.description: Canonical containing-folder path. `/` is the workspace root.

content.description: Initial file content. Omit or send an empty string to create a zero-byte file.

post.description: Create an upload session and signed control token. Empty files and files up to and including 50 MiB receive a single signed PUT URL; larger files receive multipart transfer instructions. The maximum file size is 5 GB.

delete.description: Abort an incomplete upload and discard its provider parts.

post.description: Issue short-lived signed PUT URLs for a bounded set of upload part numbers.

200.description: Signed URLs for the requested parts.

post.description: Verify the single PUT or assemble every multipart part, then atomically register the workspace file.

200.description: The completed upload and registered file.

get.description: Return one workspace file's metadata and current sharing state without downloading its content. Lookups are workspace-scoped: a file that belongs to another workspace returns `404`.

200.description: The file metadata and sharing state.

delete.description: Delete a file in a workspace. The operation is workspace-scoped and records its own audit entry. Returns the file id and a `deleted` acknowledgement.

409.description: The file could not be deleted because of a conflicting state.

patch.description: Rename a file. Renaming only — use `POST /api/v2/files/move` to change which folder a file lives in. A name already taken in the same folder is rejected with `409`.

workspaceId.description: The workspace that owns the file.

name.description: The new filename. Cannot contain `/`, `\`, or be `.` / `..`.

get.description: List audit log entries for an explicitly selected organization with opaque cursor pagination. These organization-scoped enterprise endpoints require a personal API key; workspace-scoped keys return `403`. The caller must belong to the selected organization, hold an admin or owner role, and have an active Enterprise subscription. The `ipAddress` and `userAgent` fields are intentionally excluded from entries for privacy.

parameters.name: organizationId
parameters.description: Organization to audit. The caller must be an admin or owner of this organization.

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: Filter by action type (e.g., file.uploaded, workflow.deployed, member.invited).

parameters.name: resourceType
parameters.description: Filter by resource type (e.g., file, workflow, workspace, member).

parameters.name: resourceId
parameters.description: Filter by a specific resource ID.

parameters.name: workspaceId
parameters.description: Filter by a workspace within your organization. Must belong to your organization, otherwise the request returns 400.

parameters.name: actorEmail
parameters.description: Filter by the email snapshot recorded for the actor who performed the action.

parameters.name: startDate
parameters.description: Only return entries at or after this ISO 8601 timestamp.

parameters.name: endDate
parameters.description: Only return entries at or before this ISO 8601 timestamp.

parameters.name: includeDeparted
parameters.description: When true, include entries from users who have left the organization. Defaults to false.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of entries to return per page. Must be between 1 and 100. Defaults to 50.

200.description: A page of audit log entries.

400.description: The request was malformed: an invalid query parameter or a `workspaceId` that does not belong to your organization.

get.description: Retrieve a single audit log entry by ID within an explicitly selected organization. This endpoint requires a personal API key; workspace-scoped keys return `403`. The caller must belong to the selected organization, hold an admin or owner role, and have an active Enterprise subscription. An entry outside that organization returns `404` (existence is not leaked). The `ipAddress` and `userAgent` fields are intentionally excluded for privacy.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The unique audit log entry identifier.

parameters.name: organizationId
parameters.description: Organization that owns the audit entry. The caller must be an admin or owner of this organization.

post.description: Move files and/or folders into a folder. `targetFolderPath: null` — or omitting it — moves the selection to the workspace root. At least one of `fileIds` or `folderPaths` must be non-empty. The whole selection moves under one lock, so a name collision at the destination fails the request with `409` instead of applying part of it.

workspaceId.description: The workspace that owns the items.

targetFolderPath.description: Canonical destination folder path. Omit to use the workspace root.

put.description: Enable a file's public share or update its access settings. Requires workspace `write`. The share token is always server-generated. Omitting `authType` on a re-enable keeps the stored mode.

workspaceId.description: The workspace that owns the file.

authType.description: How the link is gated. Omit on a re-enable to keep the stored mode.

password.description: Plaintext password for a `password` share. Required on first enable; omit to keep the stored one.

allowedEmails.description: Allowed addresses or `@domain` patterns for an `email` / `sso` share. Must be non-empty when enabling one.

delete.description: Disable a file's public share while preserving its token and stored access settings for a future re-enable. The operation is idempotent.

get.description: Stream the raw bytes of a file. The success response is the content itself, without a JSON envelope. Errors still use the canonical v2 JSON envelope.

200.description: The raw file content as binary data.

Content-Length.description: Size of the file in bytes.

put.description: Replace a file's bytes. This is a full replace, not an append: `content` becomes the entire body of the file. Use `encoding: "base64"` for non-UTF-8 bytes. The decoded body is capped at 50MB and still debits the workspace storage quota, so a write that would push the payer past its limit fails with `413`.

workspaceId.description: The workspace that owns the file.

content.description: The file's new full contents, interpreted per `encoding`.

post.description: Delete up to 1,000 files. Folder deletion is available at `/api/v2/files/folders`.

get.description: List active folders for this resource. Omit `parentPath` for the full tree, or pass a canonical path (including `/`) for immediate children only.

parameters.name: parentPath
parameters.description: Canonical parent path. `/` lists root folders; omit for every folder.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Name search.

parameters.name: sortBy
parameters.description: Sort field.

parameters.name: sortOrder
parameters.description: Sort direction.

post.description: Create exactly one folder leaf. Its parent path must already exist.

patch.description: Rename, move, or rename and move a folder. Descendant paths change with the folder.

delete.description: Delete a folder. By default the folder must be empty. With `recursive=true`, its descendant folders and resources are deleted too.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Canonical non-root folder path.

parameters.name: recursive
parameters.description: Whether to delete the subtree.

apiKey.name: X-API-Key
apiKey.description: Your Sim API key (personal or workspace). Generate one from the Sim dashboard under Settings > API Keys.

WorkspaceIdQuery.name: workspaceId
WorkspaceIdQuery.description: The unique identifier of the workspace.

UploadTokenHeader.name: upload-token
UploadTokenHeader.description: The signed control token returned when the upload session was created.

FileIdPath.name: fileId
FileIdPath.description: The unique identifier of the file.

Cursor.name: cursor
Cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor. Pass the `nextCursor` value from a previous response to fetch the next page.

X-RateLimit-Limit.description: The maximum number of requests permitted in the current rate-limit window.

X-RateLimit-Remaining.description: The number of requests remaining in the current rate-limit window.

X-RateLimit-Reset.description: ISO 8601 timestamp at which the current rate-limit window resets.

V2File.description: A workspace file as exposed by the v2 surface.

uploadedByEmail.description: Current email address of the uploader.

uploadedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the file was uploaded.

folderPath.description: Canonical containing-folder path. `/` is the workspace root.

updatedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the last write, content or metadata.

V2DeleteFileResult.description: Acknowledgement returned by a successful delete.

id.description: The unique identifier of the deleted file.

deleted.description: Always true on a successful delete.

V2AuditLogEntry.description: A public enterprise audit log entry. The ipAddress and userAgent fields are intentionally excluded for privacy.

id.description: Unique identifier for the audit log entry.

workspaceId.description: The workspace where the action occurred, or null for organization-level actions.

actorName.description: Display name of the person who performed the action.

actorEmail.description: Email address of the person who performed the action.

action.description: The action that was performed (e.g., file.uploaded, workflow.deployed).

resourceType.description: The type of resource affected (e.g., file, workflow, workspace, member).

resourceId.description: The unique identifier of the affected resource.

resourceName.description: Display name of the affected resource.

metadata.description: Arbitrary per-action metadata as JSON. The shape varies by action type and may be null for some actions.

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the action occurred.

V2FileListResponse.description: A page of files plus the cursor for the next page.

nextCursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page, or null when there are no more results.

V2FileDescriptionResponse.description: A single file with its current sharing state.

V2DeleteFileResponse.description: The result of archiving a file.

V2AuditLogListResponse.description: A page of audit log entries plus the cursor for the next page.

data.description: The audit log entries in this page.

nextCursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page, or null when there are no more results.

V2AuditLogResponse.description: A single audit log entry resource.

code.description: Stable, machine-readable error code (e.g., BAD_REQUEST, NOT_FOUND, RATE_LIMITED).

details.description: Optional structured error context. For validation errors this is an array of field-level issues; for rate limiting it carries the reset timestamp.

V2FileSharing.description: The file's current sharing state. Disabled sharing carries no stale access details.

path.description: Canonical folder path. This is the public folder identifier.

parentPath.description: Canonical parent path; `/` is the root.

BadRequest.description: Invalid request. Inspect `error.message` and the optional `error.details` for specifics.

Unauthorized.description: Invalid or missing API key. Ensure the X-API-Key header is set with a valid key.

Forbidden.description: Access denied. For Files, the API key lacks access to the workspace. For Audit Logs, this requires an Enterprise subscription and an organization admin or owner role.

NotFound.description: The requested resource was not found, or it does not belong to the authorized scope.

RateLimited.description: Rate limit exceeded. Wait for the duration in the Retry-After header before retrying.

Retry-After.description: Number of seconds to wait before retrying the request.

InternalError.description: An unexpected error occurred on the server.

Conflict.description: The request conflicts with existing state — most often a name already taken in the destination folder.

error.message: A file named "data.csv" already exists in this workspace

PayloadTooLarge.description: The body exceeds the per-request size limit, or accepting it would push the workspace past its storage quota.
